ABOUT THE HOME: Good Day Sunshine is a gorgeous 5 bedroom (4 Kings!) 4.5 bath, recently renovated home (2,900 sq ft. sleeps 16) in the beautiful resort community of Seacrest Beach. This beautiful coastal home has all the comforts and luxuries you would expect. It's outfitted top to bottom in Pottery Barn and West Elm furniture, brand new Helix comfort mattresses, and TVs in every bedroom.

With 3 floors of living space, it's perfect for large groups or multiple families. The first floor is equipped with a family room, dining room (with table for ten), fully stocked kitchen, laundry room, and ensuite master bedroom. There is a large deck on the front of the house for drinking your morning coffee (Keurig and drip) or spending the evening with your family and friends. And that's not all . . . Behind the house in the back entrance, there is a full-size garage where you will find complimentary bikes, beach chairs, beach toys, and umbrellas are also there for you use - everything you need for a perfect day at the beach!

ABOUT THE AREA: It's just a short walk to the majestic 12,000 square-foot pool or the private beach, or you also have the option of catching the complimentary tram that runs from 9am to 6pm, March through October. Also nearby are the resort towns of Rosemary and Alys Beach where there are first rate restaurants and shops. In addition to the beach and pool, there are lots of outdoor activities to enjoy. A bike path (Timpoochee Trail) runs the length of 30A (18 miles!) if you want a longer ride. Check out all the neighboring towns, coastal dune lakes and state parks along the way. You won't be disappointed.

AMENITY ACCESS: In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas.

*** Attention Guests, please note that there is an additional fee of $2 per day per guest staying at this property in Seacrest Beach. We are required by the Seacrest Beach HOA to collect this fee in order for you to stay in this community and use their amenities. We will collect this fee prior to your arrival.

BEACH ACCESS: Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 – King
• Bedroom 2 – King
• Bedroom 3 – King
• Bedroom 4 – King
• Bedroom 5 - Bunk Room - 2 Twin/Twin/Twin (sleeps 6)
• 3rd Floor room – Trundle (sleeps 2)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Covered deck with outdoor seating and dining space
• Community Pool 12,000 sq ft. (unheated)
• 4 bikes included
• Gas Grill
• Master on Main
• 2 Living Room Spaces
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker – pods and drip
• Washer/Dryer
• Full linen package: bedding & bath towels, wash clothes
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida’s famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you’ll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- *** Pet Friendly Home ($250/dog NRF)

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces. Seacrest Beach also has parallel parking spots throughout the community.

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff. We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: We spent Christmas at Good Day Sunshine with our 3 adult children and their spouses. The house was well equipped with everything we needed to prepare meals. Because the area was experiencing an unusual cold spell, we were thankful for the family room and 3rd floor area to play games and watch Christmas movies. Once the weather warmed up, we were able to enjoy the short walk to the beach and viewed a beautiful sunset. We also used the bikes that were available on the property to explore the area. We enjoyed having a washer and dryer available so we were able to have a suitcase of clean clothes for our trip back home. It was easy to check in and check out. Would definitely stay again!
